mentions.name: firefox-translator
mentions.description: This Android app provides offline-only translation using Mozilla's translation models running on device, along with Tesseract. It is currently alpha quality but working, and the developer is figuring out F-Droid publishing.
mentions.source_excerpt:
An offline-only translator app for Android, using Mozilla's translation models (on device) and Tesseract.

App is alpha quality but working: https://github.com/davidventura/firefox-translator
